body_lines: في أبولو 11 عام 1969، نشر باز ألدرين
image_credit: Photo: NASA / Neil Armstrong · Scan: Kipp Teague
image_description: Apollo 11 photo AS11-40-5872: Buzz Aldrin unfurling the solar wind composition experiment beside Eagle, July 20 1969.
rights_scope: Informational editorial Telegram preview with NASA photo acknowledgment; no endorsement or promotional use.
verified_facts: Apollo 11 solar wind collector was a sheet of foil.
Facing the Sun, it trapped particles from the solar wind.
The collector returned to Earth for laboratory analysis.
